text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled CONFIG-ONLY tweak for change window 22:30-00:30 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 20% for 20m -> full. Changes: routing.policy.global_weight 0.90 -> 0.75; batching.max_requests 20 -> 12; batching.max_tokens 2500 -> 1600; request.timeout_ms 24000 -> 36000. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/ghi789. Rollback rules in PR: auto-rollback if error_rate delta >0.45% sustained 8m OR p99 increases >220ms sustained 10m. Auto-unpin if gateway_errors >0.33%. Dashboards to watch: per-tenant p95/p99, kvcache_hit_rate, token_cost_rate.

maria.g: ack. I'll watch premium tenants and confirm no pinned tenants are affected. Will start warmup for slim variant 10m before promoting past canary.

samk: question: global_weight change may route more PLG traffic to slim variant; have we run A/B evals on representative prompt-sets? We should sample for quality drift.

deploy-bot: global weight is a nudge for unpinned traffic only. Pinned routing remains intact. QA sampling advised during canary.

oliver: lowering max_tokens and batch size could increase KV cache churn. Recommend short warmup and monitor cache hit rate. Also watch backend queue lengths.

qa-bot: quick monitoring commands for ops:
```
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=kvcache.hit_rate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MON" | jq .value
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/query?metric=request.errors" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MON" | jq .value
```
Expected baseline: kvcache_hit_rate >= 0.92.

oncall-amber: I'll be oncall and in #eng-oncall. If deploy-bot suggests rollback, ping me for immediate approval. Manual rollback threshold: error_rate >0.35% sustained 5m AND ops consensus.

maria.g: warmup started at 22:20 UTC. Observed a small transient in hit rate to 0.89 for 2m, recovered to 0.93.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 22:31 UTC (5%). Initial metrics: error_rate 0.01%, p99 +12ms, kvcache_hit_rate 0.93. Monitoring.

samk: running quality snapshot on sample of 800 canary requests; will report in 12m.

deploy-bot: Canary stable at 14m. Promoting to 20% at 22:46 UTC.

maria.g: holding an eye on enterprise tenant M-317; pinned to heavy variant but routing logs show minimal routing divergence. All good.

samk: QA snapshot: negligible relevancy change for 1.6% of samples, acceptable.

deploy-bot: Promotion to 20% complete. Monitoring 20m then will proceed to full if stable. Logs: https://console.redwood/logs/deploy/ghi789

oncall-amber: staying until 00:00 UTC. If we see sustained gateway errors >0.2% or error_rate >0.3% escalate to rollback.

oliver: if kvcache_hit_rate drops below 0.90 again, pause rollout and run synthetic warmup.

maria.g: release note draft: "Config-only: global routing weight smoothing toward slim variants, reduced batching parameters, and increased request timeout to tolerate slower tails. Expected: improved operational cost and p95 stability; monitor p99 for edge-case regressions." I'll add to changelog.

deploy-bot: At 23:10 UTC promoted to 100%. Final checks OK. Closing thread; file release notes and attach commit ghi789. If any tenant issues surface, open incident and reference this thread.
